title: What's new: Match Production Database Configuration (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Accessing the match production configuration button

features.name: Match Production Configuration
features.description: A feature that allows administrators to temporarily match the configuration of a sandbox database to that of a typical production database, enabling developers to evaluate how processes would run in a production environment.
features.status_evidence_quote: A new feature we're shipping in 2026 release wave two.
caveats: Limited to three occurrences per tenant per calendar month
Each occurrence lasts for 72 hours only
Environment automatically reverts to typical sandbox configuration after 72 hours
Only available on tenants with paid license type
Disconnects all connected users when activated

features.name: Match Production Configuration Button
features.description: A new button in the admin center for sandbox environments labeled match production configuration that initiates the configuration matching process.
caveats: Appears only in sandbox environment admin center

features.name: Operation Tracking for Configuration Matching
features.description: Administrators can track the match production configuration operation in the admin center like any other operation, with operation details showing who initiated it, when it started, and when the environment is expected to revert to regular sandbox configuration.

features.name: Admin Center APIs for Configuration Matching
features.description: The match production configuration operation is supported through admin center APIs, allowing developers to automate the configuration matching as part of their development processes.
